summary.name: The Art of SLOs (DevOpsDays Chicago 2019)
summary.one_liner: A YouTube video of a 2019 DevOpsDays Chicago talk by Jennifer Petoff and Nathen Harvey on service level objectives (SLOs).
use_cases: learning how to define service level objectives
watching a DevOps conference talk on reliability
understanding SLO practices for SRE teams
preparing a team talk on SLOs
summary.what_it_does: The page is a YouTube video page for "DevOpsDays Chicago 2019 - Jennifer Petoff & Nathen Harvey - The Art of SLOs", uploaded by the DevOpsDays Chicago channel on 13 Sep 2019 (14:34 runtime is shown in the sidebar, not confirmed for this video). It has 879 views and 11 likes at the time of capture. The page text contains only the video title, channel, date and stats, plus unrelated recommended videos. The talk's actual content, slides or claims are not present in the page text, so this summary does not describe what is said in it.
notable: Conference talk by Jennifer Petoff and Nathen Harvey from DevOpsDays Chicago 2019
Listed in dastergon/awesome-sre under Service Level Agreement
caveats: Page text contains no talk transcript or description, so the content is not verified here
Recommended-video sidebar text is unrelated to the talk and was ignored
